content.title: Longfu88 Login Guide for New Players in Singapore
content.label: Create the account, log in, then verify it

content.article: Longfu88 admits a player to the account when the pair of credentials typed in matches what was set during sign-up. Players under 18 are not accepted, while this text is written with Singapore readers in mind. Since signing in presupposes an existing account, the page begins with registration and the welcome offer. Next come the Longfu88 casino login and the password reset, followed by verification, account security and support. Each section deals with a single task, so the page can be followed from the first step to the last.

Step 1: Longfu88 Register and Create Your Account

Longfu88 takes new accounts through e-mail registration alone, as no other route is offered. Five steps make up the procedure, and each depends on the one before it, so they should be followed in sequence.

  1. Start from the casino homepage by clicking Register.
  2. Choose a password and enter it beside the e-mail.
  3. Acceptance of the Terms and Conditions and of the Privacy Policy is recorded here, along with confirmation of adult age.
  4. Provide the other personal particulars and the address of residence.
  5. Click Create Account, and deal with the confirmation message by e-mail whenever the casino asks for one.

Apart from the login pair, the form collects a residential address along with the legal name and birth date. Two eligibility rules apply. A player must have turned 18 and reached the age at which gambling is legal for the jurisdiction concerned, and a second personal account for the same player is not permitted. Whoever fits these rules can sign up and continue to the login step further down this page. The pair chosen here, e-mail plus password, is what the login will ask for later.

What a New Account Can Claim

Among the first things a new account can claim is the Casino Welcome Bonus. It rewards the first deposit with 18 free spins and a match of 188%, capped at €2,088. An opening deposit needs to reach a minimum of €50. Activation comes first and takes place in My Bonuses, since no bet may be placed before that. Betting through 25 times the deposit and bonus together clears the wagering, while whatever the free spins win falls under a separate 40x condition. A single spin may be backed with at most €22.5, and 10 days from activation is how long the bonus lasts.

The sequence at Longfu88 never changes. A player first signs up and fills in the personal details, then makes the qualifying deposit and activates the bonus. Only after that do eligible casino games count towards the wagering, which must be completed before the bonus expires. Anyone weighing this offer against other casino bonuses should do that comparison before depositing.

Step 2: Log In

Signing in needs only what was entered at registration. The Longfu login is built on the registered e-mail plus its password, and no further credential is requested in the steps listed here. Three stages make up the procedure at Longfu88, and the last one may include a security check before the account is opened.

  1. Click Login on the casino site.
  2. Type the registered e-mail, then the password.
  3. Clear the security check wherever it shows up, which brings the player into the account.

What is typed into the e-mail field must equal the registered address. That check comes ahead of access to the account. A player who cannot recall the password may use the reset covered next, while a login that keeps failing is addressed by the checks after it.

If You Forget the Password

Recovery of a lost password begins on the login screen and ends with a link delivered by e-mail. Three steps cover it.

  1. Click Forgot Password, found on the sign-in screen.
  2. Order a reset link by giving the address that was registered.
  3. Open the message that arrives and carry out its instructions, which end in a new password.

Without access to that inbox, the matter goes to customer support, whose channels appear in the help section below.

When the Login Does Not Work

Small typing slips cause most failed logins, so the first checks are easy ones. Spelling of the e-mail should match the registration letter for letter, caps lock should be off with the right keyboard layout active, and a forgotten password calls for the reset described earlier. If none of this helps, the reason may sit with the account itself. Longfu88 has the right to freeze activity while documents are checked, or when misuse is suspected, and the player may have to wait for entry until that review ends. Such a case belongs with support, which answers through the 24/7 chat window and also takes e-mail.

Step 3: Verify the Account

Verification means that the casino confirms, through submitted documents, that the account belongs to the person who registered it. Longfu88 does not require this at sign-up or at login. A request is made in four situations: when the account comes under review, ahead of any withdrawal, when transfers of money look unusual or very large, and if account or payment information is changed. Proof of identity, for instance a passport, comes first, and the table lists the other kinds. Documents on the source of funds are needed solely if the casino asks for them.

Category Documents that qualify
Who the player is Passport, driving licence, or the identity card issued nationally
Where the player lives Either a utility bill or else a statement issued by the bank
Payment method Ownership proof for the bank account or card used, or for a digital wallet
Origin of funds Proof of income, statements from banks and any other supporting financial papers

After a request, the documents are due within 30 days at most. A complete submission is normally processed within 10 days at the latest.

Keeping the Account Safe

Responsibility for the login details lies first with the account holder, who has to keep the registered e-mail address and its password safe. The operator carries a share of the work too. Longfu88 uses technical and organizational measures to guard personal data, payments and accounts. It can also suspend activity when verification is due or abuse is suspected. As the login consists of nothing beyond e-mail and password, a player who keeps the password private and resets it after losing it covers the part of security that depends on the player.

What Opens After the Login

Once signed in, a player finds Longfu88 open to the sportsbook and the casino and also to bonuses, deposits and withdrawals. Inside the casino, the lobby is sorted into game categories, which can be scanned at a glance:

  • Jackpots
  • Lottery
  • Fast games
  • Slots
  • P2P games
  • Table games
  • Fishing
  • Live dealer games
  • Crash and instant games

Money moves in and out through the cashier, and the bonuses, among them the welcome offer from the first step, are handled from the account too.

Help With Your Account

The support team looks after account matters, from login to verification. Live chat is staffed 24/7, and the mailbox is support@longfu88.com. Typical matters are trouble uploading a document, a reset message that never reaches the inbox and a sign-in that fails. Replies are available in Malay, English, Thai, Indonesian, Simplified Chinese and Vietnamese, so players in Singapore may write in whichever of these languages is the most comfortable.

faqs.question: Which personal data is requested at sign-up?
faqs.answer: A residential address, a legal name and a birth date, on top of the login pair, meaning the e-mail address paired with a password picked there.

faqs.question: What does a player type to get in?
faqs.answer: Only the credentials registered earlier, an e-mail address and its password, as the second step on this page explains.

faqs.question: How is a lost password recovered?
faqs.answer: A reset link is requested by giving the registered address, and the directions inside the message that comes back lead to a new password.

faqs.question: Is a second account allowed?
faqs.answer: No, Longfu88 limits every player to one personal account.

faqs.question: When can the welcome bonus be taken?
faqs.answer: After sign-up, at the first deposit that qualifies, with a floor of €50.

faqs.question: What if the login still does not work?
faqs.answer: Customer support steps in, with a chat window that never closes and an e-mail address as the second route.
